headlines.title: Trailblazing Feminist and Social Activist Gloria Steinem Dies at 92
headlines.description: Gloria Steinem, the pioneering feminist and journalist whose activism revolutionized the personal and professional lives of women has died at 92. Steinem dedicated her life to causes ranging from reproductive freedom and domestic violence prevention to workplace gender inequalities. NBC’s Anne Thompson looks back on her remarkable life and legacy.

headlines.title: Mass Shooting in Minneapolis Leaves 2 Dead, Several Injured
headlines.description: Police say a gunman opened fire in an apartment building in downtown Minneapolis on Wednesday, killing two people and injuring several others including three police officers. NBC’s Shaquille Brewster reports for TODAY on the latest on the investigation.

headlines.title: Pete Hegseth Faces Growing Criticism as War With Iran Rolls On
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is facing growing criticism from some Republicans, with a key senator now calling on President Donald Trump to replace him. It comes amid Hegseth’s reported plans to extend troop deployments in the Middle East, a sign that the conflict with Iran could drag into next year. Meanwhile, the war continues to escalate with Iran targeting U.S. sites across the region in response to a wave of American bombings earlier in the week. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: See USS Abraham Lincoln Sailor Reunite With Family
headlines.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln finally docked in Thailand on Wednesday, pulling into port after nearly nine months at sea. Shakira Fairfax flew from New Jersey to see her daughter Jada, one of the sailors aboard the aircraft carrier. See their first hug in nearly 300 days!

headlines.title: Inside a Ukrainian maternity ward as Russian strikes intensify
headlines.description: As Russia ramps up strikes on Ukrainian cities, one underground maternity ward is allowing women to deliver babies safely amid a brutal war. NBC News' Richard Engel went inside.

headlines.title: Is the Lindsay Clancy Murder Case on the Verge of a Mistrial?
headlines.description: Deliberations in the Lindsay Clancy triple murder trial are entering a sixth day despite jurors hitting an impasse twice. In a last-ditch effort to break their latest deadlock, the judge read the jury the Tuey-Rodriguez charge, which essentially asks the jury to give deliberations one last chance. NBC’s Emilie Ikeda reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: In Nepal, mourners hold symbolic cremation for missing loved ones
headlines.description: The wall of ice, water and rock that tore through Nepal last week has claimed more than 1,200 lives and left more than 4,000 missing, depriving many grieving families of a basic rite: funerals.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick believes Jay-Z has a ‘guilty conscience’ over deals with NFL and Target
headlines.description: Kaepernick made the comments as part of an extensive interview with NBC News ahead of the release of his memoir, “The Perilous Fight.”

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Parents arrested after death of 5-year-old nonverbal daughter to be extradited to South Carolina
headlines.description: The married couple arrested this week in connection with the death of their 5-year-old nonverbal daughter appeared in court Thursday and agreed to be extradited to South Carolina.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy jury remains deadlocked on 6th day of deliberations as mistrial looms
headlines.description: Jurors in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial have one last chance to reach a verdict before Judge William Sullivan can declare a mistrial in a case that has captivated the nation for the last six weeks.
